Dear Aikido team,

I'm applying for the Web Designer role. Your mission to make security suck less for developers resonates with me—I've spent years turning messy websites into clean, maintainable systems, and I'd love to do that for Aikido.

At Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites for clients, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles, where I created a consistent layout system. I also designed and built baverok.com from scratch, hand-coding a landing page with a WebGL hero, and optimized mirook.com with structured data and technical SEO. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily use of AI tools gives me a technical edge for simplifying Webflow setups.

I thrive in fast-moving environments, spotting issues and fixing them independently. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Ghent, and excited to bring my design-first mindset to Aikido.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Aikido team,

I'm writing to apply for the Web Designer position. Your mission to make security suck less for developers immediately caught my attention—it's a refreshing approach in an industry often bogged down by complexity. I've spent my career simplifying messy systems, and I'd love to bring that mindset to Aikido's website.

In my current role at Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites, including building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with approximately 600 member profile pages. This required creating a consistent, scalable layout system—similar to the component-based approach you're looking for. I also designed and built baverok.com from scratch, hand-coding a landing page with a WebGL hero, and optimized mirook.com with structured data and technical SEO, which measurably improved its search health. My front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily use of AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT give me a technical edge for simplifying Webflow setups and automating repetitive tasks.

I understand the importance of a design system that balances visual polish with maintainability. While my primary experience is in WordPress and Elementor, I'm confident in my ability to quickly master Webflow and apply the same principles of clean structure and reusable components. I thrive in fast-paced environments, spotting issues and fixing them independently—exactly the ownership mindset you value.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Ghent, and excited about the opportunity to work with a team that values high trust and zero corporate BS. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can contribute to Aikido's design-first approach.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:

• At Episto, building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages.
• Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor (2018-2019), developing and optimizing front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript).
